ArtifactRefV1.description:
A reference to a stored artifact — never the raw bytes themselves.

Stages pass around pointers (path + hash + mime type). The actual file
lives in the object store (S3-compatible); the manifest / envelope only
ever stores the reference.

path.description: Content-addressed storage path/key for the artifact, e.g. 's3://bucket/artifacts/<sha256>.mp4'. Must not be a mutable alias such as 'latest.mp4'.
path.title: Path

hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the artifact contents.
hash.title: Hash

mime_type.description: MIME type of the stored artifact, e.g. 'video/mp4', 'audio/wav', 'application/json'.
mime_type.title: Mime Type

created_at.description: UTC timestamp when this artifact reference was created.
created_at.title: Created At

ArtifactRefV1.title: ArtifactRefV1

Modality.description:
Which kind of video this run produces. Shared across IdeaRequestV1,
MasterVideoV1, and DisclosureDecisionV1 — import this rather than
redefining modality as a plain string elsewhere.
Modality.title: Modality

description:
The fully assembled video, prior to QC (S70) and approval (G80).

Does not carry its own hash field - video_artifact.hash (via
ArtifactRefV1) is the single source of truth for this video's identity.
HumanApprovalV1 and DisclosureDecisionV1 each store their own copy of
that hash to bind a specific decision to a specific version.

run_id.description: Which run this master video belongs to
run_id.title: Run Id

modality.description: Which kind of video this is - avatar or faceless

video_artifact.description: Reference to the assembled video file

scene_count.description: Number of scenes in this assembly
scene_count.title: Scene Count

duration_seconds.description: Total video duration, as measured by ffprobe
duration_seconds.title: Duration Seconds

metadata.description: Non-schema contextual data, mirroring StageOutputV1's metadata field - an intentional escape hatch for fields we haven't formalized yet.
metadata.title: Metadata
